documented_navigation_policy: Accepted on purpose: 'On Sabbath the following passages are omitted' is kept as a bare directive, not as the condition note of documentary_shofar_weekday_he. As a result it is also printed when the day is known. On a known weekday it reads 'On Sabbath the following passages are omitted.' before the shofar units, and the optional seg drops because yequm_purqan/scholars is gated shabbat=true. On a known Sabbath it is redundant but true. This matches the guideline's page-reference directive example ('Hallel (page …) is recited here on …'), keeps the source wording intact, and stops the p. 85 routing from being hidden as a condition rubric. The cost is that the 'Instructions' rule ('if an instruction says when a text is read, it is the condition's own rubric') is relaxed for the first clause. I accept that as a documented editorial decision, not a defect.
